description: Breaks a polyphonic cable out to four separate mono outputs, in channel order or sorted by voltage

inputs.text: The polyphonic signal to be broken out; channels beyond the fourth are dropped without warning

outputs.text: Carries one channel of the polyphonic input as a mono signal, picked by the sort order on the menu

notes: the lamp beside an output is lit while that output has a channel to carry
an output with no channel to carry is not written at all, so it holds whatever voltage it last had
with Pitch Down chosen and exactly three channels patched, an already-descending input comes out mis-sorted; the source is missing a comparison before its last swap
menu: Sort Outputs: Channel, Pitch Up, Pitch Down — takes the input channel of matching number, or sorts the channels by voltage, lowest first or highest first
